productionDate.original: 秦始皇二十八年（前 219）刻，秦二世元年（前 209）加刻
productionDate.note: The surviving characters belong to the Second Emperor's edict.

currentCollection.note: The Tai'an scenic-area page places the stone inside the east reception hall (东御座) of Dai Temple and lists it as a Grade-1 national cultural relic. It does not describe a display case, access, or a condition survey.
currentCollection.noteZh: 泰安泰山风景名胜区页面记此刻石位于岱庙东御座内，并列为国家一级文物。页面没有说明展柜、参观方式或保存状况调查。

date.note: The page says only that the stone was moved down to Dai Temple in the Qing dynasty, without a year.

provenanceEvents.summary: The stone was moved from the summit to Dai Temple. The page also says it was stolen at one point and recovered, without dating either episode.
provenanceEvents.summaryZh: 刻石自岱顶移存岱庙。页面并记其曾被盗、后又追回，两事均未记年份。

review.note: Draft object record from the Tai'an scenic-area page read on 2026-11-18. Location, relic grade and the surviving characters are stated; dimensions, condition and the dates of the moves are not.
review.noteZh: 草稿实物记录，依据 2026-11-18 阅读的泰安泰山风景名胜区页面整理。页面记有现存地点、文物级别与残存文字；尺寸、保存状况与迁移年份均未记载。

notes: The page gives ten surviving characters; it does not give the stone's size or a condition survey.
The move to Dai Temple is dated only to the Qing dynasty, so the event carries an era rather than a year.
The theft and recovery mentioned on the page are not dated and are recorded only in this note, not as separate events.
The stone is a fragment of the original stele, not a rubbing or a later copy.
notesZh: 页面记残存十字，但没有碑石尺寸或保存状况调查。
移存岱庙只记到清代，因此事件只记朝代，不填年份。
页面提到的被盗与追回没有年份，只在本条说明中记下，不单列为事件。
此石是原碑残石，不是拓本，也不是后代的摹刻。
